Democracy is a system of government in which people have the power to choose their representatives and participate in the decision-making process. It is based on the idea that every citizen should have an equal voice in matters that affect society. Democracy gives people the right to vote, express their opinions, question the government, and participate in public life. Elections are an important part of a democratic system because they allow citizens to choose their leaders. A strong democracy also protects fundamental rights, freedom of speech, equality, justice, and the rule of law. In a democracy, government institutions are expected to work according to the constitution and laws of the country. Citizens also have responsibilities such as obeying the law, respecting other people's opinions, voting responsibly, and contributing positively to society. Democracy is not only about elections; it is also about participation, accountability, transparency, and respect for different views. A healthy democracy allows people from different backgrounds to live together peacefully and discuss their differences. Therefore, democracy plays an important role in creating a fair, responsible, and inclusive society.

Docker is an open-source platform that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of applications by using containerization. It allows developers to package an application with all of its dependencies—such as libraries, configuration files, and frameworks—into a single, standardized unit called a container.
